mapper.sql: (t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{period}) or (t.task_level='week' and exists(select 1 from lab_task parent where parent.id=t.parent_id and parent.task_level='month' and parent.period=#{period} and parent.del_flag='0'))

t.id as id,t.period as period,t.biz_line as bizLine,t.title as title,t.owner_id as ownerId,t.task_level as taskLevel,t.plan_date as planDate,t.workflow_status as status,t.result_status as resultStatus,t.deliverable as deliverable,t.next_action as nextAction,t.current_block_flag as block
mapper.select: select g.id as id,g.goal_level as goalLevel,g.goal_no as goalNo,g.title as title,g.owner_id as ownerId,g.progress_rate as progressRate,g.status as status from lab_goal g left join lab_member m on m.id=g.owner_id and m.del_flag='0' and m.member_status='ACTIVE' where g.del_flag='0' and g.status in ('ACTIVE','COMPLETED') and g.year=cast(substring(#{period},1,4) as unsigned) and (g.goal_level='YEAR' or (g.goal_level='QUARTER' and g.period=concat(substring(#{period},1,4),'Q',ceil(cast(substring(#{period},6,2) as unsigned)/3)))) order by g.goal_level,g.goal_no,g.id
select from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW','CONFIRMED') and () order by t.plan_date,t.id
select from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW','CONFIRMED') and t.result_status='UNDONE' and () order by t.plan_date,t.id
select from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.task_level='month' and t.period=#{nextPeriod} order by t.plan_date,t.id

select ,t.coordination_content as coordination,t.coordination_support as coordinationSupport from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW','CONFIRMED') and t.coordination_required='1' and () and exists(select 1 from lab_collaboration_record c where c.task_id=t.id and c.period=#{period} and c.review_status='APPROVED' and c.del_flag='0') order by t.plan_date,t.id

select ,b.block_type as blockType,b.block_reason as blockReason,b.block_start_time as blockStartTime from lab_task t join lab_task_block_event b on b.task_id=t.id and b.block_status='OPEN' and b.del_flag='0' where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW') and () order by b.block_start_time,t.id

select t.workflow_status as status,t.result_status as resultStatus,count(1) as total from lab_task t where t.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('ACTIVE','PENDING_REVIEW','CONFIRMED') and () group by t.workflow_status,t.result_status order by t.workflow_status,t.result_status

select a.id as id,a.asset_no as assetNo,a.asset_name as assetName,a.asset_type as assetType,a.asset_stage as assetStage,a.primary_owner_id as ownerId,a.status as status,case when ('1'=a.critical_flag or (a.status='ACTIVE' and a.asset_stage in ('DEPLOYED','ACCEPTED'))) and (a.backup_owner_id is null or backup_member.member_status<>'ACTIVE') then true else false end as singlePointRisk from lab_asset a left join lab_member primary_member on primary_member.id=a.primary_owner_id and primary_member.del_flag='0' left join lab_member backup_member on backup_member.id=a.backup_owner_id and backup_member.del_flag='0' where a.del_flag='0' and a.status='ACTIVE' order by a.asset_type,a.asset_no,a.id

select i.id as id,i.ipr_no as iprNo,i.ipr_name as iprName,i.ipr_type as iprType,i.ipr_stage as iprStage,i.owner_id as ownerId,i.planned_submit_date as plannedSubmitDate,i.actual_submit_date as actualSubmitDate from lab_ipr i left join lab_member m on m.id=i.owner_id and m.del_flag='0' and m.member_status='ACTIVE' where i.del_flag='0' and i.status='ACTIVE' and date_format(coalesce(i.actual_submit_date,i.planned_submit_date),'%Y-%m')=#{period} order by i.ipr_type,i.ipr_no,i.id

select p.member_id as memberId,p.period as period,p.revision_no as revisionNo,p.score as score,p.result_status as resultStatus,p.red_line_flag as redLineFlag,p.confirmation_status as confirmationStatus from lab_perf_score p join lab_member m on m.id=p.member_id and m.del_flag='0' and m.member_status='ACTIVE' where p.del_flag='0' and p.current_flag='1' and p.period=#{period} order by p.member_id,p.revision_no
